items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Erroll may have gotten into it, although I'm not sure because Erroll didn't get out into the California scene -- Erroll Garner, I'm speaking of -- until after World War II.

ctx.x: for a long time and have a good time. I used to go up there quite often with Fats Waller.

Then they had other good guys that would come in and play a tune or so at a time like Nat King Cole. He was a wonderful pianist, as well as being a singer. He was one of the best pianists there was in the world. He used to come up and later, on the tail end, Erroll may have gotten into it, although I'm not sure because Erroll didn't get out into the California scene -- Erroll Garner, I'm speaking of -- until after World War II.
Yeah, it was into the late 40s.
